beats.label: S1 · Powers awaken
beats.text: Ordinary people worldwide awaken to abilities. Nurse Peter dreams of exploding above New York; office worker Hiro teleports from Tokyo; and a serial killer is stalking the powered.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Establishes the world, the two POV heroes who carry the finale, and the unseen threat that everything else orbits.

beats.label: S1 · Save the cheerleader
beats.text: A future Hiro appears to Peter with a warning: save the cheerleader, save the world. Peter rescues Claire—an indestructible teen—from the killer Sylar at her Homecoming.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Locks Peter, Claire, and Sylar into one causal chain and sets the season's mission statement.

beats.label: S1 · Sylar unmasked
beats.text: The killer is Gabriel Gray, a watchmaker who murders the powered to cut out and steal their abilities. Briefly caged by the Company, he breaks free.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Gives the antagonist a name, method, and freedom heading into the back half.

beats.label: S1 · Bennet's double life
beats.text: Claire's father Bennet is exposed as a Company operative, given her as an infant on the condition he return her once her powers surfaced. He chooses her over the Company.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Turns a villain into an ally and reframes the whole season's surveillance thread as a father protecting his daughter.

beats.label: S1 · Linderman's design
beats.text: The Vegas kingpin Linderman is orchestrating everything: rig Nathan's election, then let Peter's atomic blast level New York and reshape society. A painting shows Nathan as future President.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Reveals the season's engine—the explosion isn't an accident, it's a plan—and pulls Nathan's political arc into the main plot.

beats.label: S1 · The ruined future
beats.text: Hiro and Ando jump five years forward to a New York in ashes, ruled by Sylar wearing Nathan's face and hunting the powered as terrorists. Hiro returns convinced he must kill Sylar.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Shows what losing costs, and commits Hiro to the swordsman path that drives the finale.

beats.label: S1 · Above Manhattan
beats.text: Peter absorbs Ted's radiation and becomes the walking bomb the visions foretold. Hiro impales Sylar and vanishes to feudal Japan; Nathan flies Peter high above the city to detonate.
beats.whyLoadBearing: Converges every thread—Peter's power, Hiro's oath, Nathan's flight, Linderman's design—into the final image the reader is walking back into.

cliffhanger.text: Peter is airborne in Nathan's arms, seconds from detonating over Manhattan. Sylar lies impaled but unseen, and Hiro has disappeared into 1671 Japan.
questions: Can Nathan carry his brother high enough for either of them to survive?
Is Sylar actually dead, or did he crawl away from the sword?
How does Hiro find his way home from feudal Japan?

characters.name: Peter Petrelli
characters.line: The nurse who absorbs any ability he stands near; airborne over Manhattan, radioactive and moments from detonating.

characters.name: Nathan Petrelli
characters.line: Peter's brother, a newly elected congressman who can fly; flying his exploding sibling up and away from the city.

characters.name: Hiro Nakamura
characters.line: Tokyo office worker who can freeze time and teleport; vanished to 1671 Japan after impaling Sylar with a katana.

characters.name: Sylar (Gabriel Gray)
characters.line: The season's killer, a watchmaker who takes other heroes' powers by cutting into their heads; run through and left behind at Kirby Plaza.

characters.name: Claire Bennet
characters.line: The indestructible cheerleader Peter was sent to save; now living with her biological grandmother Angela after Bennet sent her into hiding.

characters.name: Noah Bennet
characters.line: Claire's adoptive father, the Company operative who broke with them to keep her safe.

characters.name: Mohinder Suresh
characters.line: Geneticist continuing his late father's hunt for the powered; now caring for the orphaned tracker Molly.

characters.name: Matt Parkman
characters.line: Telepathic ex-cop who joined the heroes; left bleeding out from four bullets in the final confrontation.

characters.name: Niki Sanders
characters.line: Former host of the murderous alter-ego Jessica; reunited with husband D.L. and son Micah after Linderman's death.

characters.name: Ando Masahashi
characters.line: Hiro's best friend and translator; sent home to Japan for safety before Hiro faced Sylar alone.
